highlights: 130W Super Fast Charging: Equipped with 2*USB C ports and 1*USB A port, UGREEN power bank fast charging supports power up 3 devices at once. USB C1 100W+USB C2 30W provides rapid charging for your laptop and phone simultaneously, MacBook Pro 16'' can be charged to 43% in just 30 mins while an iPhone 15 can also be charged to 60% at the same time, worry-free work anytime, anywhere.

20000mAh Large Capacity: UGREEN laptop power bank 20000mAh keeps your devices charged for days, fully charging iPhone 15 4 times, iPad Pro 11" up to 2 times, and MacBook Air 13" up to 1.3 times. Ideal for on-the-go, say goodbye to power anxiety.

Premium Digital Display: The advanced TFT screen displays detailed information including battery level, real-time voltage, real-time current, and charging power of different ports. You can intuitively understand the working status of each interface and the power distribution. Status at a glance, everything is under control.

Powerful & Portable: Adopts the advanced power-column design, the portable charger maximizes space utilization shrinks size to 5.1 × 2.1 × 2 inches, easily be held in the palm. Weighing only 480g, reducing the burden on your journey, carrying a high-power and high-capacity charging assistant without any fuss.

Charge what you want: UGREEN battery pack supports charging protocols such as PD, PPS, QC, AFC, FCP, SCP, compatible with almost all devices like MacBook Pro 16''/Air 15", iPad Pro 2024/Air 5, iPhone 15 Pro Max/Pro/Plus/15, Galaxy S24/S23 Ultra, Steam Deck, Switch, also supports smaller devices like AirPods, smart watches, etc.
